solutions.title: Sorted windows
solutions.strategy: Sort the pattern once, sort each same-length window, and collect matching starts.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of the n-m+1 windows of length m is sorted before comparison.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A sorted copy of one window and the pattern are stored during comparison.

solutions.title: Sliding frequency
solutions.strategy: Maintain fixed-size character counts for the current window and update them as the window slides.

timeComplexity.explanation: The scan touches each text character a constant number of times, with a fixed alphabet-size comparison.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Two frequency arrays store counts for the alphabet.
